scope: Retrospective partial adaptation of weekly time-series momentum, NOT exact replication, NOT trading/PnL

source.license: Binance Vision terms, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless otherwise designated; noncommercial research only

literature: Liu/Tsyvinski, Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency, NBER working paper24877 (2018), weekly momentum component only, not attention/network factors nor published performance replication
signal: Every Sunday after UTC session close, with at least84 daily returns available
target: close[t+8]/open[t+2]-1, seven-session Tuesday-through-Monday holding-price benchmark, after a full intervening day. Price benchmark NOT a guaranteed fill. BTCUSDT return, not exact USD return or excess return.
split: Assign by Sunday signal year. All completed targets by final dataset date only. Reset/freeze each model at first Sunday of each outer year; expanding train from available prior weekly examples with target_end<=first_signal_cutoff. No tuning/inner selection.
objective: Ridge mean squared error + alpha*sum(nonintercept_weights**2); solve normal equations with XTX/n+alpha*diag(0,1,...). OLS intercept+momentum7 via lstsq. No SGD, gradient iterations, C mapping or hyperparameter search.
preprocessing: Per-fit median/IQR on mature training examples only; zero IQR->1; clip [-5,5]. Freeze during outer year. OLS uses the same intercept and scaled momentum7 column as ridge.
primary_metric: MSE; report R2_OOS=1-MSE_model/MSE_historical_mean, pooled with observation weights. Baseline mean estimated on that block train only.
secondary_metrics: all cohorts and all models, not selecting favorable one
uncertainty: Exploratory paired loss(model)-loss(historical_mean) circular moving-block bootstrap within each year, fixed lengths4 and12weeks,2000 replicates,seed1701, percentile95intervals. Negative favors model. Not multiplicity-adjusted or correction for previously inspected data. Both lengths reported, no favorable interval selection.
budget: Six model fits per pass (OLS+ridge x3years), plus three historical means and zero constant. Two identical complete passes=12 model fits. No HPO or search for seed, horizon, universe, alpha or threshold.
caveats: Different task/metric from closed intraday probability experiment; cannot present this as improvement of its log-loss
Original study period/assets/data, label, estimators and factors not reproduced; call partial adaptation only
Weekly sample small and not independent merely because target intervals do not overlap; no pristine holdout
Source onlyBTC currently; no claim representative of all markets or microcoins
No costs/filters/latency/fill availability verified. No net PnL, Sharpe, shorts, population, Laya, live orders or paid inference
No choosing winner based on external metrics or intervals; confirmation needs truly future observations
